coverage.subtopic: Left superior-division middle cerebral artery infarction with Broca aphasia
coverage.learning_objective: Dominant superior-division MCA infarction injures Broca area and lateral face-arm motor cortex, causing nonfluent aphasia with contralateral face and arm weakness.

coverage.subtopic: Subepithelial immune deposits with spike-and-dome basement-membrane remodeling
coverage.learning_objective: Membranous nephropathy produces subepithelial immune deposits and intervening basement-membrane spikes, causing nephrotic proteinuria with granular capillary-loop staining.

coverage.subtopic: Immune-complex complement activation with subepithelial humps
coverage.learning_objective: Poststreptococcal glomerulonephritis results from immune-complex deposition and complement activation, producing low C3, granular staining, and subepithelial humps.

coverage.subtopic: Elevated intrapleural pressure causing mediastinal shift and reduced venous return
coverage.learning_objective: Tension pneumothorax causes obstructive shock by increasing intrathoracic pressure and compressing systemic veins, thereby reducing venous return and cardiac output.

coverage.subtopic: Autoantibodies against BP180/BP230 hemidesmosomal proteins with subepidermal separation
coverage.learning_objective: Bullous pemphigoid targets BP180/BP230 hemidesmosomes, causing subepidermal tense bullae and linear IgG/C3 deposition at the basement-membrane zone.

coverage.subtopic: Disruption of medial circumflex femoral retinacular branches and osteonecrosis
coverage.learning_objective: Displaced intracapsular femoral-neck fractures can interrupt medial circumflex femoral retinacular branches, leading to femoral-head osteonecrosis.

coverage.subsystem: Ischemic heart disease and infarct healing
coverage.subtopic: Days 3-7 macrophage-mediated tissue softening and mechanical rupture
coverage.learning_objective: Macrophage-mediated removal of necrotic myocardium during days 3-7 precedes adequate collagen deposition, creating the period of greatest mechanical rupture risk.

coverage.subsystem: Granulomatous bacterial infection and immunomodulator risk
coverage.subtopic: TNF-alpha-dependent granuloma maintenance and reactivation during infliximab therapy
coverage.learning_objective: TNF-alpha maintains the architecture and antimicrobial function of tuberculous granulomas; anti-TNF therapy can reactivate latent tuberculosis.
